noticias.titulo: 2 Large-Cap Stocks to Research Further and 1 We Question
noticias.resumen: Large-cap stocks are known for their staying power and ability to weather market storms better than smaller competitors. However, their sheer size makes it more challenging to maintain high growth rates as they’ve already captured significant portions of their markets.
